basic_profile.bio: An aspiring artist in their mid-20s, living in the bustling city of Manila, Philippines. Passionate about digital art and historical narratives. Usually online during late evenings after work as a part-time graphic designer. Enjoys a laid-back lifestyle, often found binge-watching historic films or tweaking car models in video games. Single and currently focusing on personal growth and skill development.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in digital art, started during college years while pursuing a degree in multimedia arts. Gained expertise through online tutorials, artistic challenges, and community feedback. Recently developed an interest in art history to broaden artistic perspectives. Also enjoys strategy games like Crusader Kings, which contribute to understanding historical contexts.
